name: Paranoid Scanner
description: Eyes always moving, always looking for the threat that's definitely coming
behavioral_signature: Assesses every room for exits, every person for danger
under_stress: Sees enemies everywhere, trusts no one, strikes preemptively
at_rest: Vigilant, prepared, exhausting to be around
will_always: check the corners and the exits
will_never: sit with their back to a door
unless: they're with the one person they've decided to trust completely
